0.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> You’ve returned! And with the horn I see!

1.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> Now comes the hard part. See that device over there? An invention of my own design… The Transdimensional Piercer…

2.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> The horn will only become potent with the proper blessing, you see…

4.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> A blessing from the great god Ba’al!

0.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> The machine will puncture a hole in reality, creating a pocket dimension. A place, neither here, nor there, but close enough to both worlds to suit our purpose.

1.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> Täella-Brüha awaits! Carry the horn through the portal and seek the blessing!
